context:
Implement in smallest safe increments:

1) Fix runner lifecycle first. Introduce strict setup/teardown structure using
   `try/finally` so overrides cannot leak on exceptions or early return paths.
2) Add stream-aware setup path for TPC-DS where overrides are derived per stream
   context used by current query batch. Reuse extractor cache by `(seed, sf, stream_id)`.
3) Expand extractor coverage using expected-key-gated pattern extraction and
   query-driven prioritization. Do not attempt full SQL parsing.
4) Add targeted tests for each failure mode and parity behavior before broader test runs.
description:
Follow-up work is required after adversarial review of the DataFrame parameter
substitution parity implementation (commit e6d83095). Three concrete issues were
identified:

1. Override lifecycle bug (P1): module-level parameter overrides can leak across
   runs because setup happens before query discovery and cleanup is not guaranteed
   for early returns or unexpected exceptions.
2. Stream parity gap (P1): TPC-DS override extraction currently ignores stream_id,
   but DataFrame execution iterates stream IDs across warmup/measurement iterations.
   This breaks SQL/DataFrame substitution parity for stream-varying runs.
3. Extractor coverage gap (P2): TPC-DS extraction supports only a narrow set of
   parameter families, leaving many query parameters stuck on static defaults.
   This prevents robust parity claims for broad TPC-DS coverage.

This TODO closes all three issues with minimal surface-area change, explicit
guardrails, and verification targeted at correctness, parity, and regression safety.

anti_patterns.dont: clear overrides only on success paths
anti_patterns.why: runner exceptions and early returns are common enough to leak global state

anti_patterns.dont: introduce a full SQL parser for extraction
anti_patterns.why: query templates are known and pattern extraction is sufficient and faster

anti_patterns.dont: move override state into DataFrameContext or query function signatures
anti_patterns.instead: keep injection through existing parameter accessors
anti_patterns.why: this would fan out changes across all adapters and query registrations

anti_patterns.dont: silently claim full parity coverage if unsupported parameter keys remain
anti_patterns.instead: explicitly track and document supported/uncovered key sets

anti_patterns.dont: treat one extracted TPC-DS override map as valid for all streams

preserves.behavior: If qgen/dsqgen extraction fails, behavior remains graceful fallback to static defaults with warning logs
No API/signature changes to `DataFrameContext` protocol or query registration callables
Runner continues emitting warmup and measurement results with existing iteration/stream metadata fields
TPC permutation ordering logic is untouched (TPCHStreams and TPCDSPermutationGenerator remain authoritative)
TPC-H behavior remains unchanged except for cleanup hardening where shared runner flow is touched
When no seed is provided, DataFrame queries continue using static defaults exactly as before
